content:
Waveshare PiRack-M6F is a multi-node server cluster kit for Raspberry Pi 4/5 designed for 10-inch 2U racks and supporting up to six Model B SBCs with all ports brought to the front panel. We wrote about rack mounts for Raspberry Pi SBCs before with products such as KKSB 10-inch and 19-inch rack panels and MyElectronics’ 19-inch 2U & 3U rack mounts, but those are mostly mechanical solutions. The PiRack-M6F adds some add-on boards to bring all Raspberry Pi ports to the front, add a debug connector (Pi 5 only), and a screw terminal at the back for 5V power. It also supports HAT and add-on boards, for instance, to add PoE support.
